name: footer-columns
description: Multi-column site footer with brand, navigation columns, social links, and legal line. Reads heavily from src/site.config.ts; per-page slots add grouped link columns.

ai.whenToUse: Use as the site-wide footer on every page. Reads brand/tagline/social/legal from site.config; adds optional grouped link columns from the `columns` slot (Product / Company / Resources, etc.).
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use two footers. Don't put marketing CTAs here — those belong in cta-strip directly above.

tagline.description: Short tagline under the brand mark. Falls back to site.tagline.
tagline.example: The deploy platform built for teams that ship.

columns.description: Grouped nav columns. Each column has a title + an array of links.

privacyLabel.description: Label for the Privacy link in the legal row. Falls back to 'Privacy'.

termsLabel.description: Label for the Terms link in the legal row. Falls back to 'Terms'.

navAriaLabel.description: Accessibility label for the footer navigation element.
